ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْا رَبَّكُمْ١ۚ اِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَیْءٌ عَظِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: O mankind, fear the (wrath of) your Lord! Indeed, the earthquake of the Hour (of Judgement) will be an awesome thing.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّاۤ اَرْضَعَتْ وَ تَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَ تَرَى النَّاسَ سُكٰرٰى وَ مَا هُمْ بِسُكٰرٰى وَ لٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللّٰهِ شَدِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: On the Day when you witness it, the suckling woman shall utterly neglect the infant she suckles, and every pregnant woman shall cast her burden, and you will see people as though they are drunk, when they are not drunk; but dreadful shall be Allah's chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ یُّجَادِلُ فِی اللّٰهِ بِغَیْرِ عِلْمٍ وَّ یَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَیْطٰنٍ مَّرِیْدٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Among people there are some who wrangle about Allah without knowledge and follow every rebellious devil,

ayahs.arabicText: كُتِبَ عَلَیْهِ اَنَّهٗ مَنْ تَوَلَّاهُ فَاَنَّهٗ یُضِلُّهٗ وَ یَهْدِیْهِ اِلٰى عَذَابِ السَّعِیْرِ
ayahs.translation: although it is decreed about him that he shall lead into error whosoever takes him for a friend, and will direct him to the torment of the Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِیْ رَیْبٍ مِّنَ الْبَعْثِ فَاِنَّا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ مِّنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَّ غَیْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَیِّنَ لَكُمْ١ؕ وَ نُقِرُّ فِی الْاَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ اِلٰۤى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوْۤا اَشُدَّكُمْ١ۚ وَ مِنْكُمْ مَّنْ یُّتَوَفّٰى وَ مِنْكُمْ مَّنْ یُّرَدُّ اِلٰۤى اَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَیْلَا یَعْلَمَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَیْئًا١ؕ وَ تَرَى الْاَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَاِذَاۤ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَیْهَا الْمَآءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَ رَبَتْ وَ اَنْۢبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِیْجٍ
ayahs.translation: O mankind! If you have any doubt concerning Resurrection, then know that it is surely We Who created you from dust, then from a drop of sperm, then from a clot of blood, then from a little lump of flesh, some of it shapely and other shapeless. (We are rehearsing this) that We may make the reality clear to you. We cause (the drop of sperm) that We please to remain in the wombs till an appointed time. We bring you forth as infants (and nurture you) that you may come of age. Among you is he that dies (at a young age) and he who is kept back to the most abject age so that after once having known, he reaches a stage when he knows nothing. You see the earth dry and barren and then no sooner than We send down water upon it, it begins to quiver and swell and brings forth every kind of beauteous vegetation.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَ اَنَّهٗ یُحْیِ الْمَوْتٰى وَ اَنَّهٗ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌۙ
ayahs.translation: All this is because Allah, He is the Truth, and because He resurrects the dead, and because He has power over everything,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِیَةٌ لَّا رَیْبَ فِیْهَا١ۙ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ یَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِی الْقُبُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: (all of which shows that) the Hour shall surely come to pass - in this there is no doubt - and Allah shall surely resurrect those that are in graves.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ یُّجَادِلُ فِی اللّٰهِ بِغَیْرِ عِلْمٍ وَّ لَا هُدًى وَّ لَا كِتٰبٍ مُّنِیْرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: And among people are those that wrangle about Allah without knowledge, without any true guidance, and without any scripture to enlighten them.

ayahs.arabicText: ثَانِیَ عِطْفِهٖ لِیُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ لَهٗ فِی الدُّنْیَا خِزْیٌ وَّ نُذِیْقُهٗ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ عَذَابَ الْحَرِیْقِ
ayahs.translation: They wrangle arrogantly, intent on leading people astray from the Way of Allah. Such shall suffer disgrace in this world and We shall cause them to taste the chastisement of burning (in the Next).

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ یَدٰكَ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَیْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِیْدِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: That is the outcome of what your own hands have wrought, for Allah never wrongs His creatures.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ یَّعْبُدُ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى حَرْفٍ١ۚ فَاِنْ اَصَابَهٗ خَیْرُ اِ۟طْمَاَنَّ بِهٖ١ۚ وَ اِنْ اَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةُ اِ۟نْقَلَبَ عَلٰى وَجْهِهٖ١ۚ۫ خَسِرَ الدُّنْیَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةَ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: And among people is he who worships Allah on the borderline; if any good befalls him, he is satisfied; but if a trial afflicts him, he utterly turns away. He will incur the loss of this world and the Hereafter. That indeed is a clear loss.

ayahs.arabicText: یَدْعُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا یَضُرُّهٗ وَ مَا لَا یَنْفَعُهٗ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلٰلُ الْبَعِیْدُۚ
ayahs.translation: He invokes, instead of Allah, those who can neither harm nor benefit him. That indeed is straying far away.

ayahs.arabicText: یَدْعُوْا لَمَنْ ضَرُّهٗۤ اَقْرَبُ مِنْ نَّفْعِهٖ١ؕ لَبِئْسَ الْمَوْلٰى وَ لَبِئْسَ الْعَشِیْرُ
ayahs.translation: He invokes those that are more likely to cause him harm than benefit. Such is surely an evil patron, and an evil associate.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یُدْخِلُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یَفْعَلُ مَا یُرِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: (In contrast) Allah will assuredly cause those who believe and act righteously to enter Gardens beneath which rivers flow. For, most certainly, Allah does whatever He pleases.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ كَانَ یَظُنُّ اَنْ لَّنْ یَّنْصُرَهُ اللّٰهُ فِی الدُّنْیَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ فَلْیَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ اِلَى السَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْیَقْطَعْ فَلْیَنْظُرْ هَلْ یُذْهِبَنَّ كَیْدُهٗ مَا یَغِیْظُ
ayahs.translation: Anyone who fancies that Allah will not support him in this world and in the Hereafter, let him reach out to heaven through a rope, and then make a hole in the sky and see whether his device can avert that which enrages him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ اٰیٰتٍۭ بَیِّنٰتٍ١ۙ وَّ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ یَهْدِیْ مَنْ یُّرِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: Even so We have revealed the Qur'an with Clear Signs. Verily Allah guides whomsoever He wills.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ الَّذِیْنَ هَادُوْا وَ الصّٰبِئِیْنَ وَ النَّصٰرٰى وَ الْمَجُوْسَ وَ الَّذِیْنَ اَشْرَكُوْۤا١ۖۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یَفْصِلُ بَیْنَهُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ شَهِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: On the Day of Resurrection Allah will most certainly judge among those who believe, and those who became Jews, and Sabaeans, and Christians, and Magians, and those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely Allah watches over everything.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ یَسْجُدُ لَهٗ مَنْ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَنْ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ الشَّمْسُ وَ الْقَمَرُ وَ النُّجُوْمُ وَ الْجِبَالُ وَ الشَّجَرُ وَ الدَّوَآبُّ وَ كَثِیْرٌ مِّنَ النَّاسِ١ؕ وَ كَثِیْرٌ حَقَّ عَلَیْهِ الْعَذَابُ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یُّهِنِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ مُّكْرِمٍ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یَفْعَلُ مَا یَشَآءُؕ۩ ۞
ayahs.translation: Have you not seen that all those who are in the heavens and all those who are in the earth prostrate themselves before Allah; and so do the sun and the moon, and the stars and the mountains, and the trees, and the beasts, and so do many human beings, and even many of those who are condemned to chastisement? And he whom Allah humiliates, none can give him honour. Allah does whatever He wills.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذٰنِ خَصْمٰنِ اخْتَصَمُوْا فِیْ رَبِّهِمْ١٘ فَالَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِیَابٌ مِّنْ نَّارٍ١ؕ یُصَبُّ مِنْ فَوْقِ رُءُوْسِهِمُ الْحَمِیْمُۚ
ayahs.translation: These two groups (the believers and unbelievers) are in dispute about their Lord. As for those that disbelieve, garments of fire have been cut out for them; boiling water shall be poured down over their heads,

ayahs.arabicText: یُصْهَرُ بِهٖ مَا فِیْ بُطُوْنِهِمْ وَ الْجُلُوْدُؕ
ayahs.translation: causing (not only) their skins but all that is in their bellies as well to melt away.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَهُمْ مَّقَامِعُ مِنْ حَدِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: There shall be maces of iron to lash them.

ayahs.arabicText: كُلَّمَاۤ اَرَادُوْۤا اَنْ یَّخْرُجُوْا مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ اُعِیْدُوْا فِیْهَا١ۗ وَ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْحَرِیْقِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Whenever they try, in their anguish, to escape from Hell, they will be driven back into it, (and shall be told): "Now taste the torment of burning."

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یُدْخِلُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ یُحَلَّوْنَ فِیْهَا مِنْ اَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَّ لُؤْلُؤًا١ؕ وَ لِبَاسُهُمْ فِیْهَا حَرِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: (On the other hand), Allah will cause those who believed and acted righteously to enter the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They shall be decked in them with bracelets of gold and pearls and their raiment shall be of silk.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُدُوْۤا اِلَى الطَّیِّبِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ١ۖۚ وَ هُدُوْۤا اِلٰى صِرَاطِ الْحَمِیْدِ
ayahs.translation: They were guided (to accept) the pure word; they were guided to the Way of the Praiseworthy (Lord).

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ یَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ وَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ الَّذِیْ جَعَلْنٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءَ اِ۟لْعَاكِفُ فِیْهِ وَ الْبَادِ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یُّرِدْ فِیْهِ بِاِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِیْمٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Indeed those who disbelieve and who (now) hinder people from the Way of Allah and hinder them from the Holy Mosque which We have set up (as a place of worship) for all people, equally for those who dwell therein and for those who come from outside, (they surely deserve punishment). Whosoever deviates therein from the Right Way and acts with iniquity, We shall cause him to taste a painful chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذْ بَوَّاْنَا لِاِبْرٰهِیْمَ مَكَانَ الْبَیْتِ اَنْ لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِیْ شَیْئًا وَّ طَهِّرْ بَیْتِیَ لِلطَّآئِفِیْنَ وَ الْقَآئِمِیْنَ وَ الرُّكَّعِ السُّجُوْدِ
ayahs.translation: Call to mind when We assigned to Abraham the site of the House (Kabah), directing him: "Do not associate aught with Me" and "Keep My House pure for those who walk around it, and for those who stand and who bow down and who prostrate themselves (in worship),

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَذِّنْ فِی النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ یَاْتُوْكَ رِجَالًا وَّ عَلٰى كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ یَّاْتِیْنَ مِنْ كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِیْقٍۙ
ayahs.translation: and publicly proclaim Pilgrimage for all mankind so that they come to you on foot and mounted on lean camels from every distant point

ayahs.arabicText: لِّیَشْهَدُوْا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْ وَ یَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللّٰهِ فِیْۤ اَیَّامٍ مَّعْلُوْمٰتٍ عَلٰى مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَهِیْمَةِ الْاَنْعَامِ١ۚ فَكُلُوْا مِنْهَا وَ اَطْعِمُوا الْبَآئِسَ الْفَقِیْرَ٘
ayahs.translation: to witness the benefits in store for them, and pronounce the name of Allah during the appointed days over the cattle that He has provided them. So eat of it and feed the distressed and the needy.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ لْیَقْضُوْا تَفَثَهُمْ وَ لْیُوْفُوْا نُذُوْرَهُمْ وَ لْیَطَّوَّفُوْا بِالْبَیْتِ الْعَتِیْقِ
ayahs.translation: Thereafter, let them tidy up and fulfil their vows and circumambulate the Ancient House."

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ١ۗ وَ مَنْ یُّعَظِّمْ حُرُمٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَهُوَ خَیْرٌ لَّهٗ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖ١ؕ وَ اُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ الْاَنْعَامُ اِلَّا مَا یُتْلٰى عَلَیْكُمْ فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْاَوْثَانِ وَ اجْتَنِبُوْا قَوْلَ الزُّوْرِۙ
ayahs.translation: Such (was the purpose of building the Kabah). Whosoever, then, venerates Allah's sanctities will find it to be good for him in the sight of his Lord. Cattle have been made lawful for you except those mentioned to you (as unlawful). So shun the abomination of idols and shun all words of falsehood.

ayahs.arabicText: حُنَفَآءَ لِلّٰهِ غَیْرَ مُشْرِكِیْنَ بِهٖ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یُّشْرِكْ بِاللّٰهِ فَكَاَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ الطَّیْرُ اَوْ تَهْوِیْ بِهِ الرِّیْحُ فِیْ مَكَانٍ سَحِیْقٍ
ayahs.translation: Become exclusively devoted to Allah, ascribing Divinity to none other than Him. Whoso ascribes Divinity to aught beside Allah, it is as though he fell down from the sky whereafter either the birds will snatch him away, or the wind will sweep him to a distant place (causing him to be shattered to pieces).

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ١ۗ وَ مَنْ یُّعَظِّمْ شَعَآئِرَ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّهَا مِنْ تَقْوَى الْقُلُوْبِ
ayahs.translation: Such is the fact. And whoso venerates the sanctity of all that have been ordained as symbols of Allah surely does so because it is part of the true piety of the hearts.

ayahs.arabicText: لَكُمْ فِیْهَا مَنَافِعُ اِلٰۤى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَاۤ اِلَى الْبَیْتِ الْعَتِیْقِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: You may derive benefit (from sacrificial animals) until an appointed time. Thereafter their place (of sacrifice) is near the Ancient House.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنْسَكًا لِّیَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللّٰهِ عَلٰى مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَهِیْمَةِ الْاَنْعَامِ١ؕ فَاِلٰهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَلَهٗۤ اَسْلِمُوْا١ؕ وَ بَشِّرِ الْمُخْبِتِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: For every people We have laid down a ritual of sacrifice(- although the purpose of the ritual is the same -)that they pronounce the name of Allah over the cattle He has provided them. Your Lord is One God; so submit yourselves to Him alone. And give, (O Prophet), glad tidings to those that humble themselves (before Allah),

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ اِذَا ذُكِرَ اللّٰهُ وَ جِلَتْ قُلُوْبُهُمْ وَ الصّٰبِرِیْنَ عَلٰى مَاۤ اَصَابَهُمْ وَ الْمُقِیْمِی الصَّلٰوةِ١ۙ وَ مِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ یُنْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: whose hearts shiver whenever Allah is mentioned, who patiently bear whatever affliction comes to them, who establish Prayer, and who spend (for good purposes) out of what We have provided them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنٰهَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللّٰهِ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا خَیْرٌ١ۖۗ فَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللّٰهِ عَلَیْهَا صَوَآفَّ١ۚ فَاِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوْبُهَا فَكُلُوْا مِنْهَا وَ اَطْعِمُوا الْقَانِعَ وَ الْمُعْتَرَّ١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We have appointed sacrificial camels among the symbols of (devotion to) Allah. There is much good in them for you. So make them stand (at the time of sacrifice) and pronounce the name of Allah over them, and when they fall down on their sides (after they are slaughtered), eat and also feed them who do not ask and those who ask. Thus have We subjected these animals that you may give thanks.

ayahs.arabicText: لَنْ یَّنَالَ اللّٰهَ لُحُوْمُهَا وَ لَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَ لٰكِنْ یَّنَالُهُ التَّقْوٰى مِنْكُمْ١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا اللّٰهَ عَلٰى مَا هَدٰىكُمْ١ؕ وَ بَشِّرِ الْمُحْسِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Neither their flesh reaches Allah nor their blood; it is your piety that reaches Him. He has subjected these animals (to you) that you may magnify Allah for the guidance He has bestowed upon you. Give glad tidings, (O Prophet), to those who do good.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یُدٰفِعُ عَنِ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُوْرٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah defends those who believe. Certainly Allah has no love for the perfidious, the thankless.

ayahs.arabicText: اُذِنَ لِلَّذِیْنَ یُقٰتَلُوْنَ بِاَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوْا١ؕ وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیْرُۙ
ayahs.translation: Permission (to fight) has been granted to those for they have been wronged. Verily Allah has the power to help them:

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لَّذِیْنَ اُخْرِجُوْا مِنْ دِیَارِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ یَّقُوْلُوْا رَبُّنَا اللّٰهُ١ؕ وَ لَوْ لَا دَفْعُ اللّٰهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَامِعُ وَ بِیَعٌ وَّ صَلَوٰتٌ وَّ مَسٰجِدُ یُذْكَرُ فِیْهَا اسْمُ اللّٰهِ كَثِیْرًا١ؕ وَ لَیَنْصُرَنَّ اللّٰهُ مَنْ یَّنْصُرُهٗ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَقَوِیٌّ عَزِیْزٌ
ayahs.translation: those who were unjustly expelled from their homes for no other reason than their saying: "Allah is Our Lord." If Allah were not to repel some through others, monasteries and churches and synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is much mentioned, would certainly have been pulled down. Allah will most certainly help those who will help Him. Verily Allah is Immensely Strong, Overwhelmingly Mighty.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّذِیْنَ اِنْ مَّكَّنّٰهُمْ فِی الْاَرْضِ اَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اٰتَوُا الزَّكٰوةَ وَ اَمَرُوْا بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَ نَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ١ؕ وَ لِلّٰهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْاُمُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: (Allah will certainly help) those who, were We to bestow authority on them in the land, will establish Prayers, render Zakah, enjoin good, and forbid evil. The end of all matters rests with Allah.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ یُّكَذِّبُوْكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّ عَادٌ وَّ ثَمُوْدُۙ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), if they give the lie to you, then before them the people of 'Ad and Thamud, also gave the lie (to the Prophets),

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَوْمُ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ وَ قَوْمُ لُوْطٍۙ
ayahs.translation: and so too did the people of Abraham and the people of Lot;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَصْحٰبُ مَدْیَنَ١ۚ وَ كُذِّبَ مُوْسٰى فَاَمْلَیْتُ لِلْكٰفِرِیْنَ ثُمَّ اَخَذْتُهُمْ١ۚ فَكَیْفَ كَانَ نَكِیْرِ
ayahs.translation: and so did the dwellers of Midian, and Moses too was branded a liar. Initially I granted respite to the unbelievers for a while and then seized them. How dreadful was My punishment!

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَاَیِّنْ مِّنْ قَرْیَةٍ اَهْلَكْنٰهَا وَ هِیَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِیَ خَاوِیَةٌ عَلٰى عُرُوْشِهَا وَ بِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَّ قَصْرٍ مَّشِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: How many towns have We destroyed because their people were steeped in iniquity: so they lie fallen down upon their turrets! How many wells lie deserted; and how many towering palaces lie in ruins!

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَمْ یَسِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَتَكُوْنَ لَهُمْ قُلُوْبٌ یَّعْقِلُوْنَ بِهَاۤ اَوْ اٰذَانٌ یَّسْمَعُوْنَ بِهَا١ۚ فَاِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى الْاَبْصَارُ وَ لٰكِنْ تَعْمَى الْقُلُوْبُ الَّتِیْ فِی الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: Have they not journeyed in the land that their hearts might understand and their ears might listen? For indeed it is not the eyes that are blinded; it is rather the hearts in the breasts that are rendered blind.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَ لَنْ یُّخْلِفَ اللّٰهُ وَعْدَهٗ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ یَوْمًا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ كَاَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They ask you to hasten the punishment. Allah shall most certainly not fail His promise; but a Day with your Lord is as a thousand years of your reckoning.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَاَیِّنْ مِّنْ قَرْیَةٍ اَمْلَیْتُ لَهَا وَ هِیَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ اَخَذْتُهَا١ۚ وَ اِلَیَّ الْمَصِیْرُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: How many towns did I respite at first though they were steeped in iniquity, and then I seized them! To Me are all destined to return.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ یٰۤاَیُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا لَكُمْ نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌۚ
ayahs.translation: Say (O Muhammad): "O people! I have been sent to you only as a plain warner (before the Doom strikes you)."

ayahs.arabicText: فَالَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّ رِزْقٌ كَرِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: So those who believe and act righteously shall be granted forgiveness and an honourable sustenance,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ سَعَوْا فِیْۤ اٰیٰتِنَا مُعٰجِزِیْنَ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ الْجَحِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: whereas those who strive against Our Signs, seeking to profane them, they are the friends of the Fire!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ وَّ لَا نَبِیٍّ اِلَّاۤ اِذَا تَمَنّٰۤى اَلْقَى الشَّیْطٰنُ فِیْۤ اُمْنِیَّتِهٖ١ۚ فَیَنْسَخُ اللّٰهُ مَا یُلْقِی الشَّیْطٰنُ ثُمَّ یُحْكِمُ اللّٰهُ اٰیٰتِهٖ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌۙ
ayahs.translation: Never did We send a Messenger or a Prophet before you (O Muhammad), but that whenever he had a desire, Satan interfered with that desire. Allah eradicates the interference of Satan and strengthens His Signs. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

ayahs.arabicText: لِّیَجْعَلَ مَا یُلْقِی الشَّیْطٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِیْنَ فِیْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ وَّ الْقَاسِیَةِ قُلُوْبُهُمْ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ لَفِیْ شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِیْدٍۙ
ayahs.translation: (He does this) in order that He may make the evil caused by Satan a trial for those in whose hearts there is sickness (of hypocrisy), whose hearts are hard (and vitiated). Surely these wrong-doers have gone too far in their dissension.

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ لِیَعْلَمَ الَّذِیْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ اَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ فَیُؤْمِنُوْا بِهٖ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهٗ قُلُوْبُهُمْ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهَادِ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: (He also does this) in order that those endowed with knowledge may know that it is the Truth from your Lord and that they may have faith in it and their hearts may humble themselves before Him. Verily Allah always directs those that believe to the Right Way.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا یَزَالُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِیْ مِرْیَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتّٰى تَاْتِیَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً اَوْ یَاْتِیَهُمْ عَذَابُ یَوْمٍ عَقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: The unbelievers will not cease to be in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly comes upon them, or the chastisement of an ominous day overtakes them.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلْمُلْكُ یَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلّٰهِ١ؕ یَحْكُمُ بَیْنَهُمْ١ؕ فَالَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فِیْ جَنّٰتِ النَّعِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: On that Day all sovereignty shall be Allah's and He will judge among them. Then those who believed and acted righteously shall be in Gardens of Bliss.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا فَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِیْنٌ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: A humiliating chastisement awaits those who disbelieved and denied Our Signs.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هَاجَرُوْا فِیْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوْۤا اَوْ مَاتُوْا لَیَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ اللّٰهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا١ؕ وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهُوَ خَیْرُ الرّٰزِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for those who migrated in the way of Allah, whereafter they were slain, or died, Allah will certainly grant them a goodly provision. Indeed, Allah is the Best of all those who provide.

ayahs.arabicText: لَیُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ مُّدْخَلًا یَّرْضَوْنَهٗ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَعَلِیْمٌ حَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: He will surely admit them to a resort which will please them. Most certainly Allah is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ١ۚ وَ مَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوْقِبَ بِهٖ ثُمَّ بُغِیَ عَلَیْهِ لَیَنْصُرَنَّهُ اللّٰهُ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: That indeed is so, as for him who retaliates in proportion to the excess committed against him, and is thereafter again subjected to transgression, Allah will surely aid him. Verily Allah is All-Pardoning, All-Forgiving.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ یُوْلِجُ الَّیْلَ فِی النَّهَارِ وَ یُوْلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِی الَّیْلِ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِیْعٌۢ بَصِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: So shall it be because it is Allah Who causes the night to emerge out of the day and causes the day to emerge out of the night and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَ اَنَّ مَا یَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ هُوَ الْبَاطِلُ وَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْعَلِیُّ الْكَبِیْرُ
ayahs.translation: So shall it be because Allah, He is the Truth, and all whom they invoke instead of Him are false. Allah is Most High, All-Great.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً١٘ فَتُصْبِحُ الْاَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَطِیْفٌ خَبِیْرٌۚ
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky whereby the earth turns green? Verily Allah is Subtle, All-Aware.

ayahs.arabicText: لَهٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الْاَرْضِ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهُوَ الْغَنِیُّ الْحَمِیْدُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Surely Allah - He alone is Self- Sufficient, Praiseworthy.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَّا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ الْفُلْكَ تَجْرِیْ فِی الْبَحْرِ بِاَمْرِهٖ١ؕ وَ یُمْسِكُ السَّمَآءَ اَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَءُوْفٌ رَّحِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Have you not seen how Allah has subjected to you all that is in the earth, and the vessels that sail in the sea by His command, and it is He Who holds back the sky that it may not fall on earth except by His leave? Surely Allah is Most Gentle, Ever Compassionate to people.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْۤ اَحْیَاكُمْ١٘ ثُمَّ یُمِیْتُكُمْ ثُمَّ یُحْیِیْكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَكَفُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: And it is He Who has endowed you with life and it is He who causes you to die, and it is He Who will then resurrect you. Man is indeed extremely prone to denying the Truth.

ayahs.arabicText: لِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنْسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوْهُ فَلَا یُنَازِعُنَّكَ فِی الْاَمْرِ وَ ادْعُ اِلٰى رَبِّكَ١ؕ اِنَّكَ لَعَلٰى هُدًى مُّسْتَقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: For every people We have prescribed a way of worship which they follow. So, (O Muhammad), let them not dispute with you concerning this, and call them to Your Lord. You are certainly on the Straight Way.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ جٰدَلُوْكَ فَقُلِ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And if they dispute with you, say: "Allah knows well what you do.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ یَحْكُمُ بَیْنَكُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ فِیْمَا كُنْتُمْ فِیْهِ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection concerning matters about which you disagreed."

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ یَعْلَمُ مَا فِی السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ فِیْ كِتٰبٍ١ؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ یَسِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Are you not aware that Allah knows all that is in the heaven and the earth? Surely it is all preserved in a Book. Indeed that is easy with Allah.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ یُنَزِّلْ بِهٖ سُلْطٰنًا وَّ مَا لَیْسَ لَهُمْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ١ؕ وَ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِیْنَ مِنْ نَّصِیْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Instead of Allah they worship those concerning whom He has revealed no sanction and concerning whom they have no true knowledge. None shall be able to help such evil-doers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَیْهِمْ اٰیٰتُنَا بَیِّنٰتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِیْ وُجُوْهِ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوا الْمُنْكَرَ١ؕ یَكَادُوْنَ یَسْطُوْنَ بِالَّذِیْنَ یَتْلُوْنَ عَلَیْهِمْ اٰیٰتِنَا١ؕ قُلْ اَفَاُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِشَرٍّ مِّنْ ذٰلِكُمْ١ؕ اَلنَّارُ١ؕ وَعَدَهَا اللّٰهُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا١ؕ وَ بِئْسَ الْمَصِیْرُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: When Our Signs are plainly recited to them, you will perceive utter repugnance on their faces and it all but seems as if they will soon pounce upon those who recite Our Signs to them. Say: "Shall I tell you what is worse than that? The Fire with which Allah has threatened those who disbelieve. That is truly an evil end."

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا النَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَاسْتَمِعُوْا لَهٗ١ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ لَنْ یَّخْلُقُوْا ذُبَابًا وَّ لَوِ اجْتَمَعُوْا لَهٗ١ؕ وَ اِنْ یَّسْلُبْهُمُ الذُّبَابُ شَیْئًا لَّا یَسْتَنْقِذُوْهُ مِنْهُ١ؕ ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الْمَطْلُوْبُ
ayahs.translation: O people, a parable is set forth: pay heed to it. Those who call upon aught other than Allah shall never be able to create even a fly, even if all of them were to come together to do that. And if the fly were to snatch away anything from them, they would not be able to recover that from it. Powerless is the supplicant; and powerless is he to whom he supplicates.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا قَدَرُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَقَوِیٌّ عَزِیْزٌ
ayahs.translation: They have not formed a true estimate of Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ یَصْطَفِیْ مِنَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَّ مِنَ النَّاسِ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِیْعٌۢ بَصِیْرٌۚ
ayahs.translation: Allah chooses Messengers from among angels and from among human beings (to convey His command). Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

ayahs.arabicText: یَعْلَمُ مَا بَیْنَ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ١ؕ وَ اِلَى اللّٰهِ تُرْجَعُ الْاُمُوْرُ
ayahs.translation: He knows all that is before them and that which is hidden from them. And it is to Allah that all affairs are returned.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوا ارْكَعُوْا وَ اسْجُدُوْا وَ اعْبُدُوْا رَبَّكُمْ وَ افْعَلُوا الْخَیْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَۚ۩ ۞
ayahs.translation: Believers, bow down and prostrate yourselves before Your Lord and serve Your Lord and do good that you may prosper.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَاهِدُوْا فِی اللّٰهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهٖ١ؕ هُوَ اجْتَبٰىكُمْ وَ مَا جَعَلَ عَلَیْكُمْ فِی الدِّیْنِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ١ؕ مِلَّةَ اَبِیْكُمْ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ١ؕ هُوَ سَمّٰىكُمُ الْمُسْلِمِیْنَ١ۙ۬ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ فِیْ هٰذَا لِیَكُوْنَ الرَّسُوْلُ شَهِیْدًا عَلَیْكُمْ وَ تَكُوْنُوْا شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ١ۖۚ فَاَقِیْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَ اعْتَصِمُوْا بِاللّٰهِ١ؕ هُوَ مَوْلٰىكُمْ١ۚ فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلٰى وَ نِعْمَ النَّصِیْرُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Strive in the cause of Allah in a manner worthy of that striving. He has chosen you (for His task), and He has not laid upon you any hardship in religion. Keep to the faith of your father Abraham. Allah named you Muslims earlier and even in this (Book), that the Messenger may be a witness over you, and that you may be witnesses over all mankind. So establish Prayer, and pay Zakah, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protector. What an excellent Protector; what an excellent Helper!
